title: First Steps Toward Automated AI Research — Richard Socher, CEO Recursive AI
talk_summary: Richard Socher argues that automating AI research (an 'Eureka machine' / recursive self-improvement) is the next big step, built from four pillars: existing knowledge, measurement data, simulations, and real experiments, orchestrated by an agent swarm. He shows three proof points where an auto-research loop improved NanoChat bits-per-byte, nanoGPT speedrun time, and CUDA kernels beyond human/community baselines.

takeaways.what_they_do: They point an agent loop at a single, cheap, fast, objectively scored benchmark (train a tiny model in <5 min, measure bits-per-byte) and let it iterate for a day or two, so every proposed change gets an automatic numeric verdict.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you train a very small chat model in less than 5 minutes and you basically want to have it get to the best possible bits per byte number
takeaways.numbers: community best 0.93 bits-per-byte; their loop reached 0.91 in ~1-2 days; nanoGPT speedrun improved by >2s to 70s

takeaways.what_they_do: They frame every automated research task as three explicit stages — propose ideas, implement them, validate empirically — with the agent swarm handling each stage over knowledge/data/simulation sources.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We have three steps: ideation, implementation, and validation of ideas. That's true for basically almost every scientific field.

takeaways.what_they_do: They explicitly checked that discovered kernels weren't gaming the benchmark, working with Nvidia to rule out reward hacks before trusting the wins.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we do just enough to make sure and work together with Nvidia to make sure that there no reward hacks here

takeaways.technique: Cheap fast proxy benchmark for iteration
takeaways.what_they_do: They deliberately chose a task trainable in under 5 minutes so the auto-research loop could run many iterations cheaply rather than on expensive full-scale runs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you train a very small chat model in less than 5 minutes
